content_html:
At this point in the symposium I was feeling very tired.

Running list of short notes from the Protocol Symposium.

Great idea from Sean Stevenson's talk at Protocol Symposium -- the test of New Nature should be that there is nobody to appeal to in a complex system.

The Polina talk was a definite vibe vacation to the Russian internet. A view of protocolized realities that are much more strongly shaped by material conditions than in the west.

Florian Lohse's talk on the idea of "time moves down the stack" suggests a general way of conceptualizing stacks: infrastructure --> structure --> superstructure --> vivistructure.

Dan Schmidt on mazes vs. protocols: one hides the path, the other publishes it — and the real question is telling which you're in.
